q: The author dedicated his new book to his wife. What is the passive voice form of the above sentence?
o: His new book was dedicated to his wife by the author.
The new book was dedicated to his wife by the author.
To his wife was dedicated the new book by the author.
His wife was dedicated the new book to by the author.
e: Double object যুক্ত বাক্যকে passive করতে দুটি object-এর একটিকে subject করা যায়। এখানে dedicated-এর object হলো his new book, আর to his wife একটি preposition-যুক্ত অংশ। তাই His new book was dedicated to his wife by the author শুদ্ধ। কাঠামো: নতুন subject + tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary + past participle + বাকি অংশ + by + পুরোনো subject। অন্য অপশনে preposition অযথা শেষে পড়েছে বা শব্দক্রম ভুল।

e: Make, see, feel, let, know, bid, watch-জাতীয় ক্রিয়ার পরে active বাক্যে to উহ্য থাকে। কিন্তু passive করলে সেই to ফিরে আসে এবং দ্বিতীয় verb-এর base form বসে। তাই John made us laugh থেকে We were made to laugh by John হয়। Laughed বা laughing বসালে ক্রিয়ার রূপ ভুল হয়, আর to be laughed অর্থ বদলে দেয়। তবে let-এর পরে active-passive কোনোটিতেই to বসে না।

q: Choose the correct passive form: 'The police have arrested the thief.'
o: The thief is arrested by the police.
The thief had been arrested by the police.
The thief was being arrested by the police.
The thief has been arrested by the police.
e:
The active sentence is in the present perfect tense (have arrested). In the passive we use 'has/have + been + past participle'. Since the new subject 'the thief' is singular, we write 'has been arrested'.
মনে রাখুন:
Present perfect passive: has/have been + V3
Past perfect passive: had been + V3
Future simple passive: will be + V3
